a.speaker: narrator
a.text: Heat hits like a wall. The Engineering Core roars around a reactor pit that glows a sick, pulsing orange.

b.speaker: halcyon
b.text: Warning. Coolant loop offline. Heat vents active throughout Engineering. Reactor containment at 61 percent.

c.speaker: bolt
c.text: Those glowing floor grates are heat vents. Step on one and you cook. Going around costs time. Going over costs skin. Your call.

d.speaker: bolt
d.text: The core control chamber is north, but the reactor pit is in the way. Maybe the maintenance tunnels on the west side?

a.speaker: bolt
a.text: Is that... is that a FLOODLIGHT ARRAY? Install it. Install it right now. Please.

b.speaker: narrator
b.text: Kai bolts the array onto BOLT's chassis. Light floods the tunnel. Every corner. Every shadow.

c.speaker: bolt
c.text: Oh. Oh wow. It's so bright. I'm never going to be afraid of the dark again. Well. Less. Less afraid.

d.speaker: narrator
d.name: New ability
d.text: BOLT learned FLASH: blinds every enemy for 2 turns. BOLT now lights a much wider area in dark rooms.

a.speaker: narrator
a.text: A man in a scorched jumpsuit is slumped against the pipes, one leg splinted with a spanner and duct tape.

b.speaker: haddad
b.name: Sgt. Haddad
b.text: Finally! I thought I'd die in here listening to that reactor hum. Omar Haddad, Tech Sergeant. Leg's broken.

c.speaker: haddad
c.name: Sgt. Haddad
c.text: I can't walk on it, but if you help me to the shelter by the lift I'll make it. I've got coolant in my kit. Worth the trip, I promise.

again.speaker: haddad
again.name: Sgt. Haddad
again.text: Still breathing. Still broken. The offer stands.

saved.speaker: haddad
saved.name: Sgt. Haddad
saved.text: Take the canisters. That thing in the core chamber is made of reactor slag. Cryo cracks it wide open. Give it hell.

a.speaker: narrator
a.text: The chamber door grinds open. Something rises from a pool of cooling slag: a hunched giant of molten rock, Bloom veins glowing through the cracks in its crust.

b.speaker: bolt
b.text: It's EATING the reactor's heat! Kai, fire won't work on this one. It'll just like it.

cool.speaker: bolt
cool.text: Coolant canisters should crack its crust. And when it glows white-hot, a canister will vent the meltdown!

nocool.speaker: bolt
nocool.text: If only we had something cold. Hit it hard, and brace or shield when it glows white-hot.

a.speaker: narrator
a.text: The Titan's crust splits apart and it crumbles into a hissing pile of cooling slag.

b.speaker: bolt
b.text: Hot. Hot hot hot. But dead! Now let's fix that coolant valve before this whole deck melts.

a.speaker: narrator
a.text: The coolant control valve is seized solid. Restoring the loop means flushing slag from the lines, one section at a time. This will take hours.

b.speaker: halcyon
b.text: Coolant loop restored. Heat vents cooling. Reactor containment stabilized. Thank you, Engineer Reyes.

c.speaker: bolt
c.text: It said thank you! HALCYON never says thank you. Kai, you're a hero. To the computer, at least.

done.speaker: narrator
done.text: Coolant flows steadily through the loop.

off.speaker: halcyon
off.text: Lift locked out. Thermal safety interlock engaged. Restore the coolant loop to release it.

a.speaker: halcyon
a.text: Lift to the Habitation Ring ready. This lift only travels up. You will not be able to return to Engineering.

choices.text: Go up to the Habitation Ring
